topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I just can't believe this is happening. They knew we were good neighbors, right? We paid our rent, we took care of the place. And now, just like that, they're flipping the whole building to condos. What does that even mean for all of us? We're supposed to just pack up and find somewhere else, I guess? Well, good luck with that. The city’s not exactly cheap. And where am I supposed to find a place that feels like home? This isn’t just a building; it’s where we’ve all made our lives. I mean, this is just... I don’t even know what to say.
